audit.notes: Very easily adapted to any big life transition (e.g., 'if I had to move to NYC again in my 20s, here's how I'd do it:'). The creator can cut together 3-4 aesthetic lifestyle clips (e.g., subway, walking through Central Park, apartment window, rooftop sunset) and place the detailed life advice in the caption.
audit.summary: A travel montage featuring airplane, airport, and European village b-roll with a reflective text hook about moving abroad in one's 20s, directing viewers to read the detailed advice in the caption.
